headline: Huge turnover for the Chiefs!
what_happened: The Chiefs' defense caught the other team's pass, which is called an interception, and took the ball back for Kansas City.
who: K.Fulton intercepted the ball from D.Jones.
why_it_matters: This is great news for your Chiefs! Stopping the other team this way gives Kansas City a much better chance to win the game.
pop_culture: This play helped Travis Kelce score a touchdown on the very next drive.
